scope: IDEA000003 and IDEA000008 only; no experiment rerun, image/raw access, or operative review

findings.title: Register-transition edges carry handoff roles
findings.actual_claim: An exact whole at an immediately ordered running/local/radial register transition should show an edge-specific owner/continuation interaction beyond whole identity, position, section, and host class.
findings.tested_or_not_tested: Not tested by the inspected predecessors. GDT790 supplies a panel-owner layer and 9 usable label/prose edges; GDT792 supplies structural host-transfer observations, while GDT388 reports no normalized ordered inscription edges. The authored ten-page bridge and GDT568 model register-conditioned frames/shared abstractions, not manuscript transition endpoints.
findings.countermodel: A whole may be a reusable register-conditioned class or local label whose adjacency reflects panel ownership, position, or section; shared strings and shared register abstractions can coexist without a handoff event.
findings.reopening: Freeze register-pair and endpoint labels, admit enough held ordered edges to pass GDT388 capacity/provenance/held/mobile-null gates, then test edge×ordered-pair interaction against whole, position, section, and host-class controls with leave-one-pair-out validation. A null after those controls would falsify this handoff mechanism; section or class frequencies alone do not.

findings.title: Exact local labels point to a prose record member
findings.actual_claim: A repeated complete label whole selects a specific nearby prose owner/item, with transfer to held panels and at least two physical folios, rather than acting as a reusable class/slot code.
findings.tested_or_not_tested: Not tested as an indexical pointer. GDT247 found 3/23 exact label/prose reuses, all PROXIMITY_ONLY; GDT790 found 9 usable edges while changing no token meanings; GDT792 explicitly retains address, class, member, name/grade/number, and opaque-family rivals and assigns zero semantic credit. No independent native owner adjudication or held owner transfer was supplied.
findings.countermodel: A generic class code can recur as a standalone label and in prose near a panel; proximity/section frequency can generate the observed pairs without selecting a singular item.
findings.reopening: Obtain independently adjudicated native panel owners plus exact occurrence joins on at least two held physical folios, with nearby-label and cross-panel equal-frequency controls. Score owner/item transfer only after direction and endpoint identity are frozen; current shared strings are not manuscript pointers.

evidence.quote:
Across 23 label groups aligned in all three readings, three exact source-native
member identities recur as complete internal prose groups:

| source surface | graphical label | neutral human geometry | prose occurrence | paragraph |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `okaly` | f80r.3 | above figure 3 | f80r.31 group 6/8 | P2 |
| `olky` | f80r.7 | above figure 7 | f80r.38 group 2/13 | P3 |
| `okal` | f82r.36 | between figure 2 and a vertical feature | f82r.6 group 6/9 | P1 |

All three equalities hold in ZL3b, IT2a, and RF1b. They are stronger than
family-shape similarity: the complete ordered member vectors and visible
source forms agree. All prose occurrences are line-internal, whereas the
graphical occurrences stand alone.

## Counterweight

The interface is sparse: only 3/23 aligned label groups match same-page prose,
and all three human ownership grades are `PROXIMITY_ONLY`. The remaining 20
labels do not have an exact local prose counterpart. Family-level matching is
broader than member-level identity, and ordinary prose itself contains many
recurrent short groups. This is a candidate code interface, not evidence for a
dictionary or a named figure.

## Complete coverage

| Scope | Count |
|---|---:|
| official images reviewed | 3 |
| visible panel owners | 10 |
| paragraph records | 13 |
| prose lines | 123 |
| prose tokens | 940 |
| graphical label loci | 27 |
| label tokens | 28 |
| exact label-token/prose occurrence edges | 10 |
| usable multi-character edges | 9 |
| token meanings changed | 0 |
| prefix/root exports | 0 |

The page-level pattern is coherent:

- f77r's label-rich upper arch owns the longest local record: eight labels and
  142 prose tokens, versus one/92 and one/87 in the other two panels.
- f82r's lower communal pool is both the most visually populated and the most
  label-heavy: twelve labels and 126 prose tokens, versus zero/72 and one/80.
- f83r's three single-figure panels have no separate labels and 72, 84 and 63
  tokens. Its lower coupled system has four labels and 122 tokens distributed
  over two main and two embedded records.

This supports panel-level ownership. It does not by itself identify the
language or turn label count into syntax.

The two new f72 label-to-prose pairs and two retained f82 pairs are exact
complete-whole reuse observations. They form only two page clusters: two f72
labels converge on one prose occurrence, while one f82 label is reused twice
in prose. The GDT388 intake returns
`VALID_ACQUISITION_NOT_SCORE_READY`, with zero eligible edges. Transcription
order is not reference direction, and every edge retains zero semantic credit.

Selecting `Ziel-/Bezugsstelle` from those shared observations would merely
repeat the previous failure mode: choose a preferred gloss first, then score
features that all rival glosses predict equally well. GDT792 records that the
raw preregistered trigger fired but deliberately withholds its semantic
consequence.

These are genuine useful geometry observations. They are not independent
record targets: the inventory has no normalized second target locus and no
ordered inscription edge in any of the four channels.

1. **Authorial connectors between labeled endpoints.** Census all 61 pages on
   30 folios in the frozen permitted-annotation frame for visible arrows, lines,
   ducts, paths, or pointers whose two endpoint inscriptions can both be
   localized. This is the only primary route that directly matches the GDT387
   relation endpoint.
2. **Normalize local text-object relations.** The 95 current positives can
   support a separate object-relation endpoint after object IDs and ownership
   are normalized, but they may not be smuggled into the parent-link test.
3. **Upgrade cross-page referents only if direction is external.** Forty frozen
   same/similar-drawing pairs have no ordered edge.
4. **Special-circle pointer census.** The 45 frozen arrays on seven folios have
   no authorial start/direction; radial or catalogue order is excluded.
5. **Q20 inter-record pointer census.** The 170 star-owned records on eight
   folios have no visible record-to-record target. OPEN/BODY is source hierarchy,
   not a relation edge.

No score is authorized until every frozen gate passes. In particular, capacity
must reach at least 50 singular directed edges on five folios, and the target
must remain mobile after matching. Confirmation planning should still prefer
the stronger GDT372 design of one to three external comparisons with many
complete arrays and multiple held folios.

Die Prosa- und Kreisseiten benutzen sehr wahrscheinlich nicht zwei völlig
verschiedene Schriftsysteme. Sie benutzen denselben kleinen Satz von
Werkstattkürzeln, aber jedes Seitenregister konkretisiert ihn anders.

Das ist der bisher einfachste Weg, alle zehn Seiten gemeinsam zu lesen:

- Im Pflanzen- und Baderegister bezeichnet `AIR` einen Lauf von Flüssigkeit.
- Im Kreisregister bezeichnet derselbe Kern einen Lauf entlang eines Rings,
  Bandes oder Zeigers.
- `AL` bleibt in beiden Registern ein Ziel.
- `AR` bleibt in beiden Registern ein Ausgang oder Bezugspunkt.
- `AIIN` bleibt ein vorgegebener Wert: in der Prosa ein Sollmaß, im Diagramm
  ein Grad oder Platzwert.
- `OK` setzt etwas in den laufenden Arbeitsgang; im Diagramm setzt oder
  aktiviert es einen Platz.
- `OT` geht zum nächsten Posten, `OL` führt denselben Satz weiter.

Das ist keine wörtliche Übersetzung von „Wasser“ in den Himmel. Es ist eine
gemeinsame technische Abstraktion. Ein Schreiber lernt den kurzen Kern
`LAUF`; das aktive Register sagt ihm, ob damit Wasserlauf oder Kreisverlauf
gemeint ist.

Das ist ein brauchbares Modell für die gesuchte Mischung: Die kurze Wurzel
trägt einen breiten, wiederverwendbaren Handlungskern; das Register wählt den
gelernten Fachrahmen. `K` muss deshalb nicht plötzlich drei verschiedene
Wörterbuchbedeutungen erhalten. `GEBEN` bleibt die gemeinsame Arbeitsbedeutung,
während Text/Himmel `zuordnen`, Pflanzen/Pharma `zugeben` und Stationen
`zuführen` als konkrete Lesestimmen benutzen.

decision: Both ideas remain untested proposals. Existing reports provide structural prerequisites and counterweights, but no distinct predeclared semantic observable or operative review is justified.
